2.8
Authentication Technologies
User authentication is implemented using JSON Web Tokens (JWT) and bcrypt password
hashing.
JWT provides stateless authentication, while bcrypt securely hashes passwords before
storage. This combination improves both security and scalability.
2.9
Related Research
Several commercial AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Google Gem-
ini provide conversational interfaces for knowledge retrieval.
However, these systems
generally rely on cloud-hosted proprietary models and may not directly operate on users’
private document collections.
The proposed Intelligent Research Assistant differs by:
• Running the language model locally using Ollama.
• Supporting private document collections.
• Generating citation-aware answers.
• Performing semantic retrieval using FAISS.
• Providing secure workspace management.
2.10
Research Gap
Existing systems often suffer from one or more of the following limitations:
• Dependence on cloud services
• Lack of document citation
• Weak support for private knowledge bases
• High operational cost
• Limited customization
The proposed system addresses these challenges through a modular Retrieval-Augmented
Generation architecture using open-source technologies.
